about: Search evaluation set (spec #1 story 48, ticket #15): realistic questions an agent or a person would ask, each mapped to the dispositivos that answer it. Authored on 2026-10-21 by reading the CF, ADCT and CDC text built from fixtures/2026-10-20 (Planalto), before any search code existed. `expected` lists `norm/id`; a question's recall@k is the share of its expected dispositivos in the top k results. `colloquial` marks questions whose key words are not the law's own ("licença-maternidade" for "licença à gestante", "nome sujo" for "informações negativas"): finding them is the synonym dictionary's job. Never edit an entry to match what the search returns; fix the search or the dictionary instead. Questions marked `holdout` were written separately by another author who saw only the law text (not the dictionary, not the search code), so recall on them estimates how the dictionary generalises.
